newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares out of steam, Rakvere suspended.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares out of steam, Rakvere suspended.

text.p: Estonian shares ran into a slight correction by the close on Wednesday after recent gains, with attention focused on Rakvere meat plant, suspended amid an investigation into alleged insider dealing in its shares.
"The fall was a normal correction and also some investors thought it was the best time for taking profits," said one trader.
The market has been steadily rising over recent sessions, buoyed by talk of bank mergers and expectations for higher estimates for 1997 profits.
Total turnover was 80 million kroons versus 102.5 million kroons and the index slipped 0.99 percent to 268.82.
Hansapank led the slowdown, falling 2.35 kroons to close 142.75 while Hoiupank fell 0.6 kroons to close at 138.3 kroons.
Forekspank was most traded with turnover of 28.2 million kroons and it lost 0.5 kroons to close at 190.5 kroons.
Rakvere was in focus as it was suspended in the second hour of trade after the securities commission asked the police to investigate a possible insider trading case.
The investigation was linked to trading in Rakvere's shares on May 14/15, when it rose sharply ahead of an announcement that it was to buy majority stake in a Latvian meat firm.
The stock market and dealers welcomed the suspension, saying it set a good precedent for investor protection by regulators.
